And you look out over the dark valley.

steady, white, electric light, on the far side of the valley. You
She sees it too. She doesn't say a word. She just
Every wire on Earth is dead.
Unless someone, somewhere, found a way around the rule.
Then the light blinks. Three times.
Like a signal. Like it knows you're watching.
So what would you do? Stay in the city, or walk away from everything?
